newsitem.title: THAILAND: Padaeng guarantees loans for subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Padaeng guarantees loans for subsidiary.

text.p: Thai zinc miner and smelter Padaeng Industry Co Ltd would guarantee a 100 million-baht short-term loan for its subsidiary, Padaeng Poongsan Metals (PPM), a Thai stock exchange statement said on Wednesday.
PPM agreed on September 11 to borrow the money from Asia Financial Syndicates Plc by issuing promisory notes with a one-year maturity.
PPM would use the loan as cash in circulation, the statement said.
Asia Financial officials declined to reveal the interest rate on the loan.
Padaeng Industry holds a 61.98 percent-stake in PPM which produces copper and brass sheet and coins.
